conceptual_distinction.21: dimension of the Pati-Salam gauge algebra / number of components in one complete adjoint seed: 15+3+3
conceptual_distinction.22: internal seed-field space 1 plus adjoint; not spacetime dimension
conceptual_distinction.claim_boundary: Pati-Salam fixes 21 only after the UV theory is assumed to contain one complete adjoint seed. The group does not force that seed to exist.

o22_boundary_condition.protected_terms: 1/2 M_X^2 X^I X^I + mu_2 S2 X^I X^I
o22_boundary_condition.controlled_breaking_spurion: mu_1 S1 X0^2 singles out the singlet direction
o22_boundary_condition.pati_salam_gauging: gauges the 21-dimensional adjoint subspace and explicitly breaks O(22)_seed

leading_log_marker.ansatz: k_a/k0 = exp[s c_g C2(adj_a) g_a^2 ln(Lambda/M)/(16 pi^2)], s=+/-1. This is a controlled viability marker, not the complete model-specific beta function.
leading_log_marker.interpretation: For an O(1) suppressive gauge coefficient, the existing SFV interval gives N_eff about 20.60 and interpolated worst flavor error about 0.89%, inside the 1% criterion. An enhancing sign or a substantially larger coefficient requires a shorter interval or additional protection.

composite_induced_mediator.leading_susceptibility: Pi_ab proportional to [[1,1],[1,22]] when all 22 seed propagators share one normalization
composite_induced_mediator.advantage: A compositeness boundary condition removes an arbitrary independent bare S mass matrix; the desired Gram matrix is the two-point susceptibility of the two seed bilinears.
composite_induced_mediator.remaining_condition: Equality of the 22 seed propagator kernels at matching, with gauge splitting quantified above.

verdict: O(22)_seed is an internal unification symmetry that can protect the common singlet/adjoint threshold at a boundary scale. The existing SFV scale separation is compatible with the 1% flavor tolerance for a leading-log suppressive gauge correction of order unity, but the sign and exact coefficient require a full model-specific RGE. The composite/induced formulation is structurally preferable because it prevents an unrelated bare mediator matrix from spoiling the 21 Gram structure.
